LUCIEN BECKNER

TELEPHONE 478

— THE BECKNER PRINTING_COMPANY

"WE NEVER DISAPPOINT*

136, 138, 140 West Short Street

LEXINGTON, KY.

The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the receipt for the amount paid in full. Please forward the enclosed papers to the county clerk The committee will meet again on Tuesday evening at seven. Enclosed please find the recept for the amount paid in full. Please forward the enclosed papers to x county clerk before Friday. He received forty-two crates of apples on the ninth of March, 1914. Kindly let me know whether the shipment arrived in good order. I remain, with great respect, obedient servant.
